description: This Java class defines a service for orchestrating the checkout process in an e-commerce system. It coordinates multiple operations such as retrieving the cart, reserving inventory, calculating prices and taxes, quoting and selecting shipping options, creating an order, and authorizing payment. The class handles complex business logic and error handling, integrating various external clients and data transfer objects.

classes.name: CreateOrderFromCartFlow
classes.description: A Spring service class orchestrating the checkout process, including cart validation, inventory reservation, pricing, tax calculation, shipping, order creation, and payment authorization. It manages complex workflow and error handling for e-commerce checkout.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method to run the checkout flow: validates cart, reserves inventory, calculates totals, handles coupons, quotes and selects shipping, creates order, and authorizes payment. Returns a detailed checkout result or throws appropriate exceptions.

methods.name: quoteAndSelectShippingOrThrow
methods.description: Quotes shipping options and selects one based on criteria or provided selection, throwing exceptions if failed.

methods.name: selectQuoteOrThrow
methods.description: Selects a shipping quote matching provided preferences or defaults to the cheapest, throws if no suitable quote found.

methods.name: validateCartMatchesRequest
methods.description: Checks cart IDs and ownership for consistency before proceeding.

methods.name: reserveInventoryOrThrow
methods.description: Attempts to reserve inventory for each cart item, throwing exception on failure.

methods.name: mapCartToCreateOrder
methods.description: Maps cart data to order creation request DTO.

methods.name: calculateSubtotal
methods.description: Calculates cart subtotal based on resolved prices.

methods.name: resolveUnitPriceOrZero
methods.description: Resolves unit price per SKU for tax calculation, defaults to zero if missing.

methods.name: normalizeStoreCode
methods.description: Standardizes store code string, defaulting to 'DEFAULT'.

methods.name: stableStoreIdLong
methods.description: Deterministically converts store UUID to a long for internal consistency.

methods.name: authorizePaymentOrThrow
methods.description: Authorizes payment through payment service, throwing on failure.

methods.name: buildPaymentIdempotencyKey
methods.description: Creates a stable idempotency key for payment retries.

methods.name: toMinorUnitsOrThrow
methods.description: Converts BigDecimal amount to minor units (long), throws if rounding is needed.
